ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two regional schematic diagrams on the left and right in the figure; shading represents ocean, and non-shading represents land. In the left figure, place Jia is located in an unshaded land area; the longitude markings on the figure are about 80° on the left and about 75° on the right, and the values decrease eastward, indicating west longitude; for latitude, the upper part is about 10° and the lower part is about 15°, and the values increase southward, indicating south latitude, so place Jia is in the Western Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere. In the right figure, place Yi is located in an unshaded land area; longitude increases eastward from 70° on the left to 75° on the right, indicating east longitude; latitude is 20° above and 15° below, increasing northward, indicating north latitude, so place Yi is in the Eastern Hemisphere and Northern Hemisphere. Then reason: From place Yi to place Jia, in terms of latitude, one must fly from the Northern Hemisphere to the Southern Hemisphere, so overall it is southward; in terms of longitude, Yi is approximately near 70°E, and Jia is approximately near 75°W. If going along the shortest distance, the longitude difference is about 70°+75°=145°, and crossing the prime meridian westward is shorter than detouring eastward, so overall it is westward. Southward and westward combine to give a southwest direction, that is, flying from northeast to southwest.

method.method_draft: First describe the two maps: identify 甲 on the left as in the Western and Southern Hemispheres, and 乙 on the right as in the Eastern and Northern Hemispheres. Then compare their coordinates along the shortest route: 乙 is north of 甲, and the shortest longitudinal displacement from 乙 to 甲 is westward rather than eastward. Combining southward latitude change with westward longitude change gives a southwest flight direction, i.e. 由东北向西南。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有左右两幅区域示意图，阴影表示海洋，非阴影表示陆地。左图中甲地位于一块非阴影陆地区域内，图上经度标注为左侧约80°、右侧约75°，数值向东减小，说明是西经；纬度上方约10°、下方约15°，数值向南增大，说明是南纬，因此甲地在西半球、南半球。右图中乙地位于非阴影陆地区域内，经度从左侧70°到右侧75°向东增大，说明是东经；纬度上方20°、下方15°，向北增大，说明是北纬，因此乙地在东半球、北半球。再推理：从乙地到甲地，纬度上要从北半球飞向南半球，所以总体向南；经度上乙约在70°E附近，甲约在75°W附近，若沿最近距离，经度差约为70°+75°=145°，向西跨越本初子午线比向东绕行更短，所以总体向西。向南与向西合成，飞行方向为西南方向，即从东北飞向西南。
